subject: Re: request for extended remit window + VAT evidence
messages:
From: accounts-payable@greenline-thera.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T09:15:00Z
Subject: Payment terms request for Q4 invoices

Hi Naomi,

We are preparing to onboard Redwood for our internal developer tooling pilot and are finalizing payment cadence for the pilot invoices. Our standard remit is Net60 for new vendors while we complete corporate onboarding. Would Redwood be able to accept Net60 for the first three invoices and move to Net30 thereafter? Also our AP team requires a VAT certificate on file that demonstrates Redwood's UK/EU VAT registration so we can apply reverse charge where applicable.

I can share the AP questionnaire and VAT form if needed. Please let me know who in your team I should coordinate with for invoicing and tax evidence.

Thanks,
Sarah Mills
Accounts Payable
Greenline Therapeutics
(attachment: Greenline_AP_questionnaire_filled.xlsx)
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: accounts-payable@greenline-thera.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T11:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for Q4 invoices

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and for sending the questionnaire. We can be flexible, but I want to propose a compromise that balances both teams' needs. Proposed plan:

- Pilot invoices: Net45 for the first two invoices, move to Net30 after pilot completion (or earlier if we hit the confirmed consumption threshold).
- Credit ceiling: we can accommodate Net45 with a provisional credit cap of $120,000 USD equivalent. If forecasted consumption exceeds that, we'll pause invoicing until payment remits or we convert to a short-term deposit.
- VAT evidence: I will attach Redwood's EU VAT registration and wiring instructions. If you provide Greenline's VAT registration cert, we can enable reverse-charge on our invoices.

Action items:
- Sarah: confirm that Net45 (two invoices) + credit cap is acceptable or let us know if you need Net60 and we should route to procurement.
- Marissa/Ben: I've looped finance to review the provisional credit cap and currency FX approach.

Regards,
Naomi
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_VAT_registration_and_wiring_instructions.pdf)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T14:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for Q4 invoices

Naomi — quick internal note: Finance is OK to approve a temporary Net45 for two invoices with a USD120k cap, provided we get Greenline's VAT cert and an AP contact in procurement who signs off on the consumption thresholds. FX exposure: Ben, please confirm whether the cap should be USD-denominated or EUR to match Greenline's legal entity.

If they insist on Net60 we should escalate to Sales Ops and Legal for a short addendum with a payment guarantee clause.

Marissa
Head of Revenue Ops
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-23T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for Q4 invoices

On Mon, 2026-11-23, marissa.cole@redwood.ai wrote:
> If they insist on Net60 we should escalate to Sales Ops and Legal for a short addendum with a payment guarantee clause.

I've modeled the exposure — set the provisional cap in USD to simplify our reporting, but include an FX buffer of 3% to account for EUR conversions. If Greenline prefers EUR cap, convert using the day-one rate and lock it in for the two-invoice window.

Also recommend we add a clause that any invoice outstanding beyond Net45 will trigger immediate suspension of access to dedicated capacity until remitted or a payment plan is agreed — that helps enforce the cap.

Ben
Senior Finance Manager, Revenue
From: accounts-payable@greenline-thera.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.mills@greenline-thera.com
Date: 2026-11-26T10:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for Q4 invoices

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick reply and for the VAT docs. Greenline can accept the Net45 proposal as a middle ground; however, we will need to submit Net60 internally for procurement approval. To keep onboarding moving, Procurement has agreed to a provisional Net60 to Redwood with the following conditions:

1) Greenline provides its VAT certificate (attached).
2) Redwood issues invoices marked for reverse-charge where applicable.
3) The provisional Net60 is valid only for the first two invoices and is capped at EUR 110,000 (approx USD 120k).
4) If Redwood exercises the suspension clause for overdue invoices, Procurement will prioritize remittance within 5 business days if we receive a suspension notice.

Attached: Greenline_VAT_certificate.pdf

Please confirm the suspension language and we will route the procurement approval.

Best,
Sarah
Accounts Payable
Greenline Therapeutics
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: accounts-payable@greenline-thera.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-29T17:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Payment terms request for Q4 invoices

Sarah — thanks, received the VAT cert and the conditions look acceptable. To summarize and confirm so Procurement has a single doc to sign:

- Term window: Provisional Net60 for first two invoices but Redwood will mark invoices with Net45 terms in our system; Greenline's Procurement requires Net60 approval and we will honor Net60 for payment processing for the two invoices only.
- Credit cap: EUR 110,000 (locked for the two-invoice window). Redwood will accept USD equivalence if you request, using the conversion rate on the invoice date + 3% FX buffer.
- Suspension clause: Redwood reserves the right to suspend dedicated resources or pause the feed if invoices are >45 days overdue — we will provide a 48-hour notice prior to suspension and Procurement will have 5 business days to remediate.
- VAT: We will apply reverse-charge on invoices where valid; thank you for the certificate.

Next steps:
1) Sarah, please confirm Procurement will sign the DocuSign link below; once signed we'll issue the first invoice for the pilot and confirm wiring instructions.
2) Marissa/Ben/Monica: please review the summary above. I'll attach the single-sheet statement for Procurement to sign and the DocuSign link once finalized.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting the pilot live.

Naomi
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
(attachment: Redwood_VAT_registration_and_wiring_instructions.pdf)
